_meta.note: DL-1007 tick 2. VM-A lock #4 PAC search. Three cells, all null on usmcmin-com-fleet-publisher/data/scorecard.json (read-only check, 22:51 ET). OpenFEC DEMO_KEY was OVER_RATE_LIMIT, so the source is the FEC.gov bulk file 'Contributions from committees to candidates' (pas226.zip, fetched live this tick). In that file the filer is the PAC and the recipient is identified by OTHER_ID/CAND_ID; recipients were matched against cm26 and cn26 fetched the same tick. Only direct 24K contributions and 24Z in-kind contributions are counted. Earmark/conduit and 24E IE rows are excluded. docquery image numbers are quoted for audit, but docquery returned HTTP 403 to curl, so they are not listed in src. TrackAIPAC /congress (live HTTP 200, 22:50 ET) lists incumbents only; neither candidate appears.
